Package app.swea2

Class DashboardView

java.lang.Object
app.swea2.DashboardView
class DashboardView extends Object
Builds the main dashboard UI.

Lays out the balance label, a recent-transactions table, a spending pie-chart, a monthly expense line-chart, and the sidebar navigation buttons.
